## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix refresh before merge because it can erase the saved fingerprint that verification needs to detect a hand edit.

## Changes

The pull request adds helpers to refresh selected fingerprints and register unlisted files, with tests for both operations.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — Refreshing `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` after a hand edit to `tracked.txt` overwrites its saved fingerprint with the edited file’s digest, so `verify` returns `True` when the other entries match. — A user adding `new.txt` can unknowingly accept the hand edit as part of the trusted baseline. — Fix: Reuse the insert-only behavior of `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries`.
